## Pre-checks (run BEFORE any test command)

### 1. Backend services check
```bash
docker-compose ps 2>/dev/null | Select-String 'keycloak|db'
curl -sf http://localhost:8081/health/ready > $null; if ($?) { Write-Output 'KC_OK' } else { Write-Output 'KC_DOWN' }
$BPM_TEST_DB_URL = 'postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test'
psql $BPM_TEST_DB_URL -c 'SELECT 1' > $null 2>&1; if ($?) { Write-Output 'DB_OK' } else { Write-Output 'DB_DOWN' }
```
If any service is down: STOP and report BLOCKER to ORCH. Do NOT attempt to start services.

### 2. Infrastructure Health Checklist (INV-TI-1)
```bash
zig build migrate 2>&1
psql $BPM_TEST_DB_URL -c 'SELECT count(*) FROM public.schema_migrations'
python3 tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration
```

### 3. Benchmark environment check
```bash
zig build bench 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 5
```
If output contains `BPM_DB_URL`, `BENCHMARK_SETUP_ERROR`, or `missing`: STOP, report BLOCKER.


